explication: FixMyStreet is a configurable civic-reporting platform: residents locate a street problem, the platform determines the responsible authority from location and problem type, and a report is sent to that authority. Public reports can be revisited for updates, while residents can subscribe to local alerts. The supplied tree and excerpts expose browser-side maps, reporting interactions, council-specific asset behavior, dashboards, and waste forms; the README supplies the broader routing, submission, and alert workflow. Backend ownership and wiring beyond those documented behaviors are not shown.
